India vs New Zealand Test Ends in Draw, WTC Final Hopes Dim

The first Test match between India and New Zealand in Wellington ended in a draw, extending India's winless streak in Tests at the venue to 58 years. Key performances from New Zealand's Mitchell and Phillips prevented an Indian victory. Following the draw, India's position in the World Test Championship (WTC) standings has been impacted, with the team currently in fourth place. This result has raised questions about India's qualification for the WTC final, with South Africa, Australia, and New Zealand occupying the top three spots.
